title: DANGEROUS ITEM!
text: DANGEROUS ITEM!. OMG! The fire dept. just left. No kidding. Made a sandwich on medium heat, electric stovetop. Something was off with cheap metal. Then, the CO detector went off. I ended up calling the authorities; insisted coming out to check for carbon monoxide poisoning. Fire truck, ambulance, police. Drama. Still upset. The pan set should be taken off the market. BTW: You cannot clean it. Ruined from one time usage. Later, I called the company. They didn't care. At all. Wonder if I had poisoning from the carbon monoxide if they'd do anything. This purchase was one that went wrong and the manufacturer doesn't care.
